items.name: Text
items.text:
Separate exchange forwarding, operator
decision-making, and delivery-provider
recording into distinct obligations.

items.name: Text
items.text:
Let holders check signed records and
public commitments without relying
on the institution’s server.

items.name: Text
items.text:
Use reproducible local scenarios and
verified testnet deployments as the
starting point for a partner pilot.

items.name: Text
items.text: Implemented today: signed receipts + public log + redemption escrow + exchange inbox.

items.text:
Direct locking starts the operator’s clock.
The holder retains control of challenges,
reclaims, disputes, and acknowledgement.

across the redemption chain. Hypothesis, not traction.

items.text:

verify customer status, balance, or eligibility.

items.name: Text

Passkeys and gas sponsorship are not implemented.

items.text:
EIP-712 binds the requester.
Private opening material stays
with the case.

Events bind obligations to
chain-observed blocks.

produce a finding per check,
without the institution’s server.

Holder dispute → DISPUTED.

holder acknowledges or dispute window expires.
